title: Indivisible quantum dynamics can be held in the present state

statements.text: Fundamental non-Markovianity is no escape from the theorem. In Barandes's indivisible stochastic formulation of quantum theory, the temporally indivisible transition law can be included in the complete present state, so a theory with non-factorizable temporal dynamics can still satisfy state sufficiency.

sources.quote: Fundamental non-Markovianity does not by itself provide an escape from the theorem.
